ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized on the distal-superior regions and 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central-inferior regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish-brown biological clusters (likely cyamids or barnacles) are attached to the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The serration pattern on the outer third of the right lobe exhibits significantly deeper valleys compared to the left lobe.
